purpose: Compare a CPU input-only classifier with a matched input/output classifier for shadow artifacts after positive tonal edits. Never substitute for functional image review.
fit: Exactly one R22 native-reviewed witness per synthetic TRAIN condition. Use accept_edit as usable and accept_decline as artifact witness only if its native visual note explicitly mentions noise, grain, speckle, stipple, mottling or blotches. Exclude uncertain. One witness per condition, group by original photo.
test_r24: Eight R24 stored original TRAIN source groups disjoint from R22 fit. Five selected complete outputs are usable. Clear artifact examples use p227 initial 3, p444 initial 3, p425 initial 3 and refined 1/2, p389 initial 3 and refined 1/2. Other outputs unscored. Same source can have both outcomes. This set was reviewed before this experiment and is not independent final acceptance.
test_historical: Both R23 LoRA seeds, native-development and old-native only. Use executed positive-tonal outputs with completed and acceptable/minor_issue review as usable and other ratings as unscored. Include fixed R21 second-seed native-dev-070 zh major-issue output as a confirmed artifact stress probe. R23 night disagreement remains unscored. Preserve per-language results and group summaries; duplicates are not independent.
models: Native sampled matched tiles. StandardScaler and logistic regression C=0.3 with balanced classes, liblinear, maximum 1000 iterations and fixed random state. Input-only uses source fields; paired also uses matched output fields. No instruction/language, model ID or slider magnitudes in features.
calibration: Four StratifiedGroupKFold folds, shuffle with seed 20261107, source group fixed. Fit threshold from pooled out-of-fold probabilities, allowing at most one usable synthetic witness blocked. Maximize detected synthetic artifacts, then minimize blocked usable, then prefer larger threshold. Refit weights on all R22 witnesses, keep threshold fixed. Fit and serialize before scoring R24 and historical.
decision: Use only offline shadow mode. A useful screen requires zero blocked reviewed useful real edits and catches all scored clear real artifact outputs including R21 stress. Report counts per source and per render, no general quality claim. No deployment or editor changes regardless of the small screen result.
